articles.title: Man dead after house fire in Etobicoke, Toronto Fire investigates
articles.summary: A man is dead after a house fire in Etobicoke early Saturday morning, said Toronto police.

articles.title: Organized crime is using encrypted messaging apps to enlist youth. This spells trouble for police
articles.summary: While police have made arrests after gunshots were fired at the U.S. Consulate in downtown Toronto in two separate incidents in recent months, finding those responsible for these alleged gun-for-hire plots remains elusive. Investigators say they are hamstrung without provisions from the federal government's controversial Bill C-22.

articles.title: 'We want it back for another 30 years': Taste of the Danforth returns after 2-year hiatus
articles.summary: The Taste of the Danforth festival has been on hiatus since 2023 after financial shortfalls, but funding from the province and the city helped bring it back, with the federal government announcing additional support just days before it kicked off.
